snippet.title: I Checked the Gas Station at Midnight. Big Mistake | Loop//Error
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3489460?utm_source=Youtube&utm_campaign=Wishlist

Alone in the dead of night, you find yourself sent on a simple errand to check on a quiet gas station on the outskirts of town. But nothing here feels right. You can’t outrun this place. It wants you. And it will keep you.

Loop//Error is a horror visual novel created by solo developer Matteo Montenero / Koro Pixel Studio. Coming to PC in October 2025
